name: Clear print queue (Windows)
description: Stops the Print Spooler, deletes only the *.SPL and *.SHD files in the spool PRINTERS folder, then starts the Spooler again. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

output: File count and bytes, then [DONE]/[SKIP] lines or a [DRY-RUN] line. Exit 0; 3 if the spooler is not running afterwards.
